summary: Loads the sub-object pointer at a1+0x19C, clears its byte flag at +0x24 to 0, copies the DWORD at a1+0x60 into the sub-object's +0x2C, and returns the sub-object pointer.

operations.description: result = *(a1 + 0x19C): load the pointer to the physics/vehicle sub-object.
Clear the sub-object byte state flag: *(result + 0x24) = 0.
Copy the source value into the sub-object: *(result + 0x2C) = *(a1 + 0x60).

unresolved: Owner object type is unknown; the fill labels the sub-object as a physics/vehicle sub-struct (DERIVED).
Meaning of the cleared flag at +0x24 and of the copied DWORD at +0x2C is not confirmed.
